_comment: All damage configs validated via check_fragment_adjacency.py. piece_1/10 = stem, piece_0 = bowl+bit of stem, piece_2/9/11 = pure rim, piece_5/6/7/8 = rim+bowl mix, piece_3/4 = bowl. rim_simple and rim_severe are two different single-piece damage spots (piece_9 vs piece_7), not an escalating size - this region didn't support a clean size progression.
